items.title: Morris French Interview
items.q: I played in the band with Sonny Henry and all them different things.

ctx.x: I guess they just swapped around so much.
I played with George Ritz a lot. I played in the band with Sonny Henry and all them different things. We rode it across the river.
He passed too, Sonny Henry. Yeah, he did. January. We were at his funeral. Sonny Henry was with what band?
